chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his men, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), said:

I asked him about the pregnant woman whose pregnancy is evident; she sees what the menstruating woman sees, from the blood. He said: That is the spilling of blood. If it is much red blood, she should not pray; and if it is little yellow blood, there is nothing upon her except ablution.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on prayer for a pregnant woman who sees blood?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the distinction between *hidaq* (heavy red blood) and *istihadha* (light yellow blood) for pregnant women, a key nuance in Shia fiqh as pregnancy does not automatically suspend menstruation. It clarifies that only heavy red bleeding invalidates prayer, while lighter discharge requires only ablution, reflecting the Imams' practical approach to varying physiological conditions.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his men, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), said,

‘I asked himasws about the pregnant woman whose pregnancy is detected, sees what the menstruating woman sees, from the blood. Heasws said: ‘That is the spilling from the blood. If it was a lot of blood, being red, so she should not pray Salaat; but if it was a little (blood), being yellow, so there is nothing upon her, except for the ablution’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from certain persons of his narrators from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“I once asked one of the Imam, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, about the case of the pregnant woman whose pregnancy has become apparent, but finds what a woman experiences because of Hayd (menses) of blood discharge. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is a spilling of blood; if the discharge is a great deal and of red color, she must not perform Salah (prayer). She then needs to take Wudu’ only if it is of a small amount and of yellow color.’”
